'''Stemzee'''<ref name="Yub Yub">{{SW|url=news/meet-the-ewoks-from-endor|text=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|int=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|nolive=1}}</ref> was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who had brown eyes and tan fur with grey stripes who lived in the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. They participated in the [[Battle of Endor]]. During the battle they manned a catapult with fellow Ewok [[Chubbray/Legends|Chubbray]]. Stemzee wore a blue hood<ref name="RotJ" /> and wielded a spear.<ref name="Star Wars: The Vintage Collection">''[[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TwoEwoksWithABHClapperboard-SWROTJVA.png|thumb|200px|left|Stemzee holding a movie slate]]
Stemzee appeared in {{Film|VI}} in scenes shot by the film's second unit near [[Wikipedia:Crescent City, California|Crescent City, California]]. During that time of production, a crewmember snapped a publicity photograph of the Ewok holding a film slate. Though [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[Leland Chee]] once speculated that was [[Nho'Apakk]], it was actually Stemzee.<ref name="LChee">{{Facebook|noprofile=1|url=permalink.php?story_fbid=499391386749353&id=201820953172172|author=Leland Chee|date=2012-11-22|nobackup=1}}</ref><ref name="EW">{{WebCite|url=http://ew.com/gallery/return-jedi-5-unseen-pics-revealed|text="'Return of the Jedi': 5 Unseen Pics Revealed!"|author=Boucher, Geoff|date=2013-05-08|work=Entertainment Weekly|archivedate=20180726082608}}</ref>

Stemzee's name was first identified when the character was included in a [[Hasbro]] action figure set, and further confirmed by an [[Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|article]] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Yub Yub" />
